title: ACES II Ejection Seat
summary: Collins Aerospace Advanced Concept Ejection Seat (ACES II) providing zero-altitude, zero-airspeed emergency escape.
role: Supports the pilot during high-G maneuvering and provides automated multi-mode emergency extraction.
materials: Aerospace aluminum structure with survival kit and drogue parachute assembly.
